sys_atf_test.description: The agent row of the ACL matrix on the child tables: an agent may read and write a task or party whose PARENT case is assigned to that agent (directly or through assigned_group), may create, and may never delete. KNOWN RED on the shipped deployment: the four scripted child- table ACLs (x_casemgmt_case_task read/write, x_casemgmt_case_party read/write) dereference the reserved word "case" as current.case, which the platform script engine refuses to compile - "missing name after . operator" - so the assigned-only narrowing denies every row. The assertions below follow AAP 0.5.6 and turn green once those ACL scripts read the parent through getValue('case') instead. The ACL artifacts are outside this unit's edit scope.
